displayContract.byline: Assessments made by 5.6 Sol. — Rubric: Slugfester Reassessment Rubric v2.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that theism remains coherent if divine maximality is defined by unrestricted competence across every genuinely possible action and truth, while nature-specific and temporal qualifications are stated consistently.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the live case by integrating its separate modal, epistemic, and nature-specific distinctions into one explicitly consistent conception.

premises.text: A capacity can be maximal by lacking any possible-task restriction without being a scalar quantity composed of infinitely many separately accumulated units.

novelty.explanation: This develops the transcript's unified-ability proposal into an explicit distinction between modal coverage and scalar magnitude.

premises.text: Knowledge of infinitely many truths need not require infinitely many independent cognitive acts if a single systematic representation entails or grounds those truths together.

novelty.explanation: This answers the residual-knowledge objection with a compression principle absent from the participant's live reply.

premises.text: Freedom is compatible with infallible knowledge when the knowledge depends explanatorily on the free choice rather than determining that choice from an independent source.

novelty.explanation: This replaces the underdefended incompatibilist assertion with a dependence-sensitive account preserving both knowledge and agency.

premises.text: Predicates may apply truthfully to an incarnate person through one nature without transferring the corresponding capacity to that person's distinct divine nature.

novelty.explanation: This elaborates the two-natures response by making its rule of personal and nature-specific predication explicit.

conclusion.text: Accordingly, Huemer's examples expose specifications that coherent theism must supply, but they do not establish contradiction once maximality, cognition, freedom, and incarnation receive these distinctions.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion proportionately consolidates repairs directed at the strongest quantitative, epistemic, and doctrinal objections.

newArguments.title: Systematic knowledge without additive storage
newArguments.text: An infinite consequence set need not correspond to infinitely many independently stored informational items. A finite axiom system can determine infinitely many theorems, and one structured state can encode a rule governing indefinitely many cases. If divine cognition is fundamentally systematic rather than proposition-by-proposition accumulation, the cardinality of known truths does not immediately measure a quantitative burden on the knower. Huemer would therefore need an additional argument showing that perfect knowledge requires additive storage or separate computational integration for every truth.

novelty.explanation: This is a new information-architecture argument using systematic representation rather than any participant's stated response.

newArguments.title: Maximality under a partial ordering
newArguments.text: Power need not be ordered by a single numerical scale. Agents can instead be compared by the inclusion relation over genuinely possible tasks: one agent is at least as powerful as another when it can perform every task the other can perform. A maximal agent occupies the unrestricted top equivalence class because no possible task lies outside its competence, not because it possesses an infinite numerical quantity. This formalization supplies the ordering relation missing from the live unified-ability reply while preserving meaningful maximality.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the missing upper-bound account by replacing scalar comparison with an explicitly defined task-inclusion ordering.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that maximal theism remains unestablished as coherent until its modal, cognitive, temporal, and incarnation distinctions are jointly modeled without hidden quantitative or predicative contradictions.

novelty.explanation: This integrates the con side's strongest objections into a single joint-consistency burden without asserting more than those objections support.

premises.text: A task-range account of power requires a principled ordering over agents and an explanation of how physically graded tasks avoid capacity magnitudes.

novelty.explanation: This strengthens the scalar objection by identifying two precise explanatory debts for any range-based alternative.

premises.text: Systematic representation does not automatically eliminate cognitive magnitude because applying a compact rule to arbitrarily detailed contingent reality may require unbounded discrimination and integration.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the residual-knowledge argument against the anticipated reply that infinitely many truths can be compressed into one representation.

premises.text: A temporal God who changes intentions needs an account of how perfect rationality permits revision without earlier error, ignorance, or changed evaluative reasons.

novelty.explanation: This redirects temporal criticism toward Swinburne's adopted view instead of the timeless conception he explicitly rejected.

premises.text: The two-natures distinction must explain how bodily predicates truthfully apply to a divine person while bodily capacities remain wholly absent from divinity.

novelty.explanation: This accepts the distinction provisionally while preserving a narrower explanatory burden concerning personal predication.

conclusion.text: Therefore, the defended theistic conception requires further joint specification before coherence is demonstrated, because each local repair creates unanswered structural questions across the remaining attributes and doctrines.

novelty.explanation: This conclusion avoids claiming outright contradiction and instead states the proportionate burden generated by incompletely integrated repairs.

newArguments.title: The integration burden
newArguments.text: Local distinctions can each appear coherent while their combination remains problematic. A temporal God with revisable intentions, infallible evaluative understanding, unrestricted task competence, and nature-specific embodiment needs one model specifying how information, reasons, decisions, and actions interact. Without that integration, a repair may simply move the difficulty: restricted foreknowledge protects freedom but threatens perfect cognition, while perfect cognition may undermine genuine revision. The con case should therefore demand a jointly satisfiable model rather than treating isolated verbal definitions as sufficient evidence of coherence.

novelty.explanation: This introduces a new constraint-satisfaction argument focused on interaction among repairs rather than any individual transcript objection.

newArguments.title: Graded tasks restore quantitative pressure
newArguments.text: Even if lifting any weight is linguistically one ability, its exercises are ordered by demandingness: lifting a larger mass under identical conditions requires at least as much causal capacity as lifting a smaller one. An unrestricted task range therefore contains an unbounded graded structure, not merely interchangeable applications of one predicate. The pro side must explain how an agent realizes every point in that structure without either possessing an unbounded capacity or denying the physically meaningful comparison between performances. This sharpens the quantitative objection without assuming that grammar determines metaphysics.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the scalar argument by grounding quantitative comparison in graded task demands rather than linguistic decomposition alone.
